title: Account Executive
description:
Shubham Forwarders is looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Accountant to manage day-to-day accounting operations, GST compliance, TDS, invoicing, bank reconciliation and financial records. The candidate should have practical knowledge of accounting software and preferably experience in logistics, freight forwarding or service-based businesses. Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Bookkeeping Maintain day-to-day accounting entries in Tally/ERP. Handle purchase, sales, receipt and payment entries. Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable. Perform bank reconciliation and ledger reconciliation. Maintain customer and vendor ledgers. 2. GST & Taxation Prepare and coordinate monthly GST returns (GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B). Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. Ensure timely GST compliance and documentation. Handle TDS calculations, deductions and payment entries. Coordinate with CA for GST, TDS and other statutory requirements. 3. Invoicing & Documentation Prepare customer invoices and vendor bills. Verify freight invoices and supporting documents. Maintain proper records of purchase and sales invoices. Monitor outstanding payments and follow up with customers. Verify foreign currency invoices and exchange-rate calculations. 4. Financial Management Maintain daily cash and bank transactions. Prepare outstanding receivable/payable reports. Monitor customer payment cycles. Assist in monthly closing and financial reporting. Maintain proper documentation for audits and bank requirements. Required Qualifications & Skills B.Com / M.Com in Commerce or Accounting. 13 years of relevant accounting experience. Good knowledge of Tally Prime. Practical knowledge of GST and TDS. Good command of MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables and formulas). Knowledge of banking transactions and reconciliation. Good written and verbal communication. Ability to work independently and maintain accuracy. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidates from freight forwarding, shipping, logistics or transportation companies will be preferred. Experience in handling foreign currency transactions will be an advantage. Should be responsible, organised and proactive. Must maintain confidentiality of company financial information. Performance Expectations (KPIs) Timely and accurate GST and TDS workings. No pending or unexplained bank reconciliation entries. Regular customer and vendor ledger reconciliation. Timely preparation of customer invoices. Regular outstanding receivable and payable reports. Proper maintenance of accounting records and documentation.

Key Skills: Payables,Tally,Reconciliation,General accounting,Accounts receivable,Accounts payable,Bank reconciliation,Receivable
